dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle at the bottom of the frame.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Mainly smooth lateral margins with a subtle asymmetrical expansion on the left lateral edge relative to the right.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse lighter-toned patches distributed across the left-hand dorsal-lateral surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradients between the primary grey baseline and the lighter mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, high-contrast white points visible on the mid-left dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white circular markings on the left mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark-pixel circular aperture (blowhole) visible on the anterior dorsal head.
